scheme_name: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered worker
Benefits are provided for up to two children
benefits_summary: Female employees receive ₹4,200 in the third month and ₹2,800 in the eighth month of pregnancy, while male employees receive ₹3,000 as paternity leave after the birth of the child.
